name: Universal Motors Israel Ltd.
summary: Universal Motors Israel Ltd engages in the sale of automotive products in Israel. It is involved in the marketing and import of GM vehicles under the Chevrolet and Cadillac brands; vehicles under the Isuzu and Maxus brands; Dongfeng vehicles under the Forthing brand; trade-in activities; and import, marketing, and sale of spare parts for vehicles. The company also engages in sale of vehicles for restoration and the sale of used vehicle spare parts; import and marketing of truck spare parts, buses, and trailers; purchase and sale of used vehicles from third party; and leasing and short-term rental of vehicles under the Avis brand; sale of vouchers for renting vehicles abroad; rental of real estate; insurance brokerage activities; retail activities in the field of office equipment, electronics, furniture, and art products; and import activities of complementary products in the field of automobiles. Universal Motors Israel Ltd was incorporated in 1993 and is headquartered in Lod, Israel.
